response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, ABS(avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean FROM per_type

assumptions.assumption: A budget amount of zero has no defined ratio, so that line is excluded from the average. Lines with spent = 0 remain included.

alternatives.interpretation: If “how far” means a signed difference, report the average minus the mean instead of its absolute distance.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_mean FROM per_type
